notes: Revisiting a finished lesson no longer means walking the whole thing again. It now opens on a list of that lesson's sections: tap the dialogue, the exercise or the wrap-up and it starts there and runs on to the end. There is also a pass over the words that lesson introduced. None of it re-marks the lesson, so your streak and today's goal are untouched; the words count as a real review once a day, so redoing a lesson an hour later is free practice and coming back tomorrow spaces them out properly.
